gaps.title: Japan Cybercab trademark covers peer-to-peer rentals; no service is announced
gaps.whyItMightMatter: JPO mark 7101386 was granted Nov 13 and reported this week; it runs to 2036 and includes vehicle rentals, but Tesla has not launched Cybercab in Japan

gaps.title: U.S. promo APR on five Model 3 and Model Y trims rises to 2.99% from 2.49%
gaps.whyItMightMatter: Second promo-rate increase in about a month; sticker prices are unchanged and Performance rates did not move with the other trims
